ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1 is an experimental JobGiver stutter-reduction build for RimWorld 1.5, based directly on the validated V0.4.18.2 aggressive baseline. JT1 profiling showed repeated JobGiver_Work calls spending most of their long-tail time in GenClosest.ClosestThingReachable, ClosestThing_Global and repeated WorkGiver boolean predicates. JS1 therefore adds a cache whose lifetime is strictly one synchronous TryIssueJobPackage call. Exact ShouldSkip, HasJobOnThing and HasJobOnCell results may be reused for the same WorkGiver, Pawn and target; early and periodic cache hits are re-run through Vanilla and a mismatch disables only that method. V0.4.18.1 nearest-first candidate ordering can also be reused inside the same package. JobOnThing/JobOnCell, Job creation, reservations and mutable game state are never cached. The low-yield V0.4.18.2 cross-package async candidate-plan experiment is retired in this build. ReachProfile behavior remains the validated V0.4.18.2 path and Path worker results remain shadow-only.
